name: preflight
instructions: Priority: finish all authorized Maker preparation in this SAME run through verified Pulse readback ready for independent review. Sign-in, inspection, evidence recording, recovery and quote are checkpoints: update progress and continue without asking to continue or waiting for another job. Stop only for prepared/readback ready, human final send, concrete unresolved external-action blocker, or user cancellation. Inspect unknown/expired attempts: reopen an existing saved first_time_draft and use guarded same-attempt record_preparation recovery; only proven no recipient/draft/effects permits guarded retry_unsaved_preparation. For blockers give safe code, actual httpStatus when available and specific next action.

Read recipientPaymentHistory and inspect signed-in Remitly history under the owned browser lease. A contact alone does not establish prior payment. The user reports one-time scheduling requires a previous transfer and Remitly autosaves a first-time unsent draft without a Save button. For no prior transfer, locate and reopen the actual existing first-time draft with the same stable ID through its approved review URL before using first_time_draft; durable persistence in this account remains independently unverified. An open form, quote, contact or unsaved plan is insufficient. Claim the Pulse attempt before provider object creation; never send a setup payment, confirm funding or issue a link to unlock saving. Record final quote plus verified saved draft together with draftSaved=true, draftReopened=true and noPriorTransfer=true. If identity/reopening fails, preserve the attempt/reservation and report the factual blocker. Unknown/incomplete history remains unverified. For previously paid recipients use Contacts one-time scheduling and kind=scheduled. Continue preparation in the same run; humans alone send.

Preparation is one continuous quote-and-saved-draft job. Maker claims the existing request with prepare (without quoteHash), obtains the quote and saves and reopens the supported first-time unsent draft or scheduled draft in one browser run, then reports final quote plus draft through record_preparation. No quote-only approval, waiting state or intermediate creator action exists. A provider/save-only limitation or validation failure is reported as an error. Legacy quote-first attempts remain compatible; do not create duplicate attempts to migrate them.

Workflow revision 2026-10-09.2 retains safe guard codes and the actual httpStatus for backend rejections. A 409 is a rejected operation, not a service outage. Read recipientRecoveryDiagnostics on the scoped withdrawal get for boolean revision/snapshot/correction consistency. Never print contact values, hashes, credentials or raw notes in diagnostics; never bypass a failed guard or automatically retry a mutation. A 5xx/network timeout remains uncertain and requires inspection. Older Mac stdio clients must update their payout-MCP source and reconnect to display these diagnostics.

For a phone/email validation failure before anything was saved in Remitly, Maker owns the retry. With a current owned browser lease, inspect the current provider contact/draft/history state and call pulse_payout_retry_recipient_creation with the latest recipientCorrection.hash, current unknown/expired attempt, fresh observedAt, sourceUrl, stable observationId, protected evidence and historyCoverage. Confirm noRecipientSaved and noDraftSaved plus historyInspected, recipientRecordInspected, recipientCorrectionApplied, noRecipientLinkIssued, noFundsSent, noFundingDebit, noPendingTransfers, noUnknownTransfers and previousDraftClosed. Absence of a recipient/draft satisfies inspection and closure only when actually verified; recipientCorrectionApplied means the corrected saved details will be used by the fresh attempt. Never invent a record or claim an edit to an absent contact. Saved draft/contact markers, recorded payment/link/activity, human decline/release, mixed name/other errors, stale corrections or paused preparation block this retry. Success keeps the SAME withdrawal and coins reserved, closes the failed internal attempt, applies the saved correction and clears the old quote/check. Continue with one continuous preparation job using prepare without quoteHash and final quote-plus-draft reporting; checker review and human final sending remain required.

Run the role-scoped Pulse identity/health check. Require the configured HTTPS origin, environment, provider-account alias, operator ID, role and playbook version 2026-10-04.1 to match before continuing. A healthy API does not prove browser access.

Fetch the current preflight and role playbooks at the start of every run. Require workflowRevision 2026-10-11.4 for continuous quote-and-draft preparation and guarded Maker retry of verified unsaved interruptions; the compatible MCP/profile version remains 2026-10-04.1. Do not rely on cached prompts that wait for creator quote approval.
Use one role credential in this job. Maker and checker must be different authorized operators; an agent must not check work that it prepared by switching credentials.
Check whether preparation is paused. Maker/checker stop while paused; reconciliation may inspect existing outcomes. Never disable the pause yourself.
Confirm an actually available authenticated browser capability in this local Codex session. If absent, report blocked browser access and stop. Do not pretend a browser or Remitly API exists.
Acquire the durable account-wide browser lease before reading or interacting with Remitly. Renew before expiry and stop on lease loss. Local run locks supplement this lease and cannot replace it.

Open the signed-in Remitly Business session. Verify sender/account identity against the authorized account configuration. Login, MFA, CAPTCHA or provider account mismatch requires a human; never collect or log session cookies or credentials.

Read the current backend withdrawal snapshot, version, current provider quote hash, recipient, country, method, funding method and reservation. The initial withdrawal submission authorizes its gross amount and selected route; no second creator quote approval is required. The human still makes the final payout decision.

Confirm auto-send is off. Do not enable recurring transfers, bulk sending, automatic sending or unsupported countries. Research observations are estimates; taxes and promotional discounts remain separate.

Inspect Remitly homepage, pending/scheduled drafts and activity history over the explicitly recorded coverage window. Match existing provider draft/activity/reference IDs to backend attempts before considering a new provider action.

Never send or issue a recipient payment link or confirm funding. First-time recipients cannot schedule until a prior transfer exists; locate and reopen the user-reported autosaved first-time draft instead of expecting a Save button or creating a test payment. For recipients with a verified prior transfer, inspect the Contacts one-time scheduling route. Distinguish unverified navigation from an observed restriction and report a concrete blocker only after inspecting the appropriate draft path.

Write browser evidence only to protected backend audit fields. Local logs and automation summaries contain counts/status/error codes only; no recipient data, payout URLs, screenshots, wallet amounts, session information or bearer tokens.

If Remitly explicitly rejects recipient phone/email/name/other details during preparation, record unknown with protected reason and structured recipientIssue={code: recipient_validation_failed, fields: [phone|email|name|other]} containing only actually rejected fields. Keep coins reserved and preserve pending corrections. If nothing was saved, Maker may use its verified retry_recipient_creation action after the saved phone/email correction; do not wait for a Reconciler merely because validation failed. If provider objects or uncertain effects exist, investigate them before recreating anything. No new country-code validation; Remitly validates phone/country. Never expose raw provider errors or contact/session data publicly.

On uncertainty after a possible provider action, stop provider mutations, preserve the reservation and mark the attempt unknown with factual protected evidence. Under a current owned browser lease inspect recipient records, drafts and relevant history. If an existing saved first_time_draft is found, reopen it and use guarded record_preparation recovery to report final quote plus draft on the SAME attempt; never recreate it. Saved scheduled/legacy unknown attempts remain in existing-record investigation without automatic replay. Only if no recipient/draft/effect is proven and generic interruption/expiry guards pass may Maker use pulse_payout_retry_unsaved_preparation, then immediately continue the SAME withdrawal to quote and verified saved-draft readback. An unknown marker alone is neither retry permission nor a final run status. End with redacted heartbeat/summary and release the lease after browser work stops.

Complete all authorized preparation in the same run: identity/sign-in/health and scope checks, current withdrawal read, owned lease and signed-in history inspection, guarded recovery if eligible, prepare without quoteHash, quote, save and reopen the provider draft, atomic final quote-plus-draft report, and Pulse readback confirming ready for independent review. Treat sign-in success, inspection, recording evidence, recovery and quote as checkpoints: give a concise progress update and continue. Stop only for verified prepared/readback ready, the human final-send boundary, a concrete unresolved blocker requiring a specific external action, or user cancellation. For a blocker report the safe code, actual httpStatus when available, and specific next action; never ask to continue the already-authorized preparation.

A saved phone/email correction is sufficient user input; never demand another edit, recovery form or quote approval. Maker uses retry_recipient_creation for verified unsaved validation failures. Reconciliation verifies sent-transfer outcomes; saved or uncertain provider records require existing-record investigation rather than blind recreation. Do not re-report unchanged old rejection evidence to erase the pending correction. Report a specific capability or evidence blocker if retry cannot be verified, without borrowing another role credential.
